title: One idea, linked. — Motion Poster preview

scenes.title: Idea becomes a system
scenes.purpose: On a single pinned poster stage, a vermilion seed idea grows into a lit disc and connects into an eight-node system, then the headline completes.
visuals: Deep ink-navy ground (#0F1B24) with stationary fixed-seed grain and a muted hairline frame
Low-value radial rays and a soft vermilion halo behind the disc
Vermilion signal disc (#E8603F) with a darker halftone dot field
Off-white links (#EFE9DD) cased in ink, plus a hub and seven nodes
Off-white heavy grotesk headline; 'linked.' and the underline rule in the signal color

beats.development: Opening still: 'One idea,' with a small vermilion seed dot. The dot gathers slightly, then expands into the full disc as the halo and rays come up.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system.

beats.development: The hub locks in, inner links draw from the hub and the inner nodes pop as the links arrive. Outer links then draw and the outer nodes appear (1 → 8 nodes). 'linked.' starts rising out of its mask.
'linked.' settles, the signal rule underlines it, and the complete poster holds for reading.

findings: The network grows in dependency order: disc, then hub, then inner links and nodes, then outer links and nodes. No node appears before its link reaches it.
All motion is settled by about 2.25 s, leaving a full-poster hold of about 0.75 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.25–3.0 s: a complete poster still for reading the headline and supporting copy.

notes: Source-frame refresh: the warm cream ground is replaced with a dark ink ground. One high-chroma signal color grows in area over time (dot, then disc, then headline word, then rule), as in the reviewed title-sequence frames. The disc reads as the light source of the scene, as in the reviewed sun-disc frames.
